name: reference-studio
description: Local workspace for collecting references and developing website art direction.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @reference-studio/core && npm run build -w @reference-studio/web && npm run build -w @reference-studio/mcp
scripts.check: tsc -b --pretty false && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.client.json --pretty false --noEmit && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.client.tests.json --pretty false --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json --pretty false --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --pretty false --noEmit
